label: interpreter-cli-matrix
command:
import json,pathlib,subprocess,tempfile; r=pathlib.Path("/Volumes/Pro2T/TraceWorktrees/rebuild-live-updates"); a=[]
for interpreter in ["/usr/bin/python3","/opt/homebrew/bin/python3.12"]:
 with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as t:
  out=pathlib.Path(t)/"attempt"; p=subprocess.run([interpreter,str(r/"Scripts/run-selected-ui-verification.py"),"--selection","Tests/Verification/ui-smoke.json","--output",str(out)],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=15); receipt=json.loads((out/"verification.json").read_text()); assert p.returncode==2 and receipt["status"]=="failed" and receipt["phases"]==[]; a.append({"interpreter":interpreter,"exitCode":p.returncode,"stderr":p.stderr.strip(),"receipt":receipt})
print(json.dumps(a,indent=2))
